title: EFT Clearing Credit on LandlordGuard Installment Fees
content:
**Incentive terms.** The LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy rewards payments that clear by bank draft. Take the number of payments received by EFT on the policy in the 12 calendar months up to the charge date, less the returned payments posted in the same months: when the result is three or more, the installment fee receives an EFT credit of 2.00 USD; when it is one or two, 1.00 USD; when it is zero or less, nothing.

The EFT credit is taken off in the fee adjustment of the installment fee.

| EFT payments received less returned payments, 12 calendar months up to the charge date | EFT credit |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2.00 USD off |
| 1 or 2 | 1.00 USD off |
| 0 or less | nothing |

## Counting

- EFT payments are payments received on this policy's premium account with the method EFT, counted by the date they were posted.
- Every returned payment posted in the same 12 months is subtracted, whatever the method of the payment it reversed.

## Hypothetical accounts

| EFT payments received | Returned payments | Difference | EFT credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0 | 4 | 2.00 USD |
| 4 | 1 | 3 | 2.00 USD |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | 1.00 USD |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | nothing |
| 0 | 2 | -2 | nothing |
